name: Clone

generation.prompt: A haunting cinematic portrait of two identical human figures standing face-to-face in a surreal, ethereal laboratory within the Hollow Hills. The environment blends organic roots and iridescent crystals with ancient alchemy. Soft, bioluminescent fungi cast a pale teal and violet glow, creating a moody, atmospheric lighting. The clones are dressed in simple, timeless linens, their expressions mirroring one another with an uncanny, symmetrical intensity. Wisps of magical silver mist swirl around their feet, emphasizing the otherworldly craft of their creation. High contrast, shallow depth of field, hyper-detailed textures of skin and fabric, mysterious and melancholic mood.

gmNotes: A Clone is biologically Human and carries the Clone (provenance) archetype; Clone is a provenance, not a Species. A Changeling is a particular clone pattern or role — a clone replacement grown and imprinted to replace an abducted human baby — not a separate Species. Clones are not Fey. Archetypes are descriptive and grant no automatic mechanics.
description: A person grown from another's pattern rather than born — made in the hollow hills or in places where the Fey work their craft. Clones can look and behave so much like the person they were patterned from that even friends are not always sure which is which. They are real people with real lives of their own.
